title: Redshift Introduces SPD-SL and Look Keo-Compatible Mousetrap
content:
On the heels (or rather, on the toes) of Redshift’s popular Mousetrap SPD adaptors, the innovative Pennsylvania brand has just released two much-anticipated sequels. The new SPD-SL and Look Keo versions of the Redshift Mousetrap are now available, and they’re even on sale!

If you’re not familiar, the Redshift Mousetrap is a removable but secure platform that can snap in and out of your clipless pedals to effectively convert them to flats. You won’t need to suffer hot spots through your Vans slip-ons, or click-clack across the patio after riding to your friends’ barbecue in your road shoes.

  • Material: Glass-Filled Nylon (Composite)
  • Weight: 170g per pair (SPD-SL), 160g per pair (Look Keo), 176g per pair (SPD)
  • Dimensions: Generously sized 80mm x 105mm platform x 10mm thick (when
  • installed, sits level with top of clipless mechanism)
  • Colors:
    • Black/Gray, Purple/Black, Teal/Pink, and Blue/Orange
  • Compatibility:
    • NEW SPD-SL: Compatible with SPD-SL and most SPD-SL-compatible clipless pedals (including Garmin & Favero)
    • NEW LOOK Keo: Compatible with LOOK Keo clipless pedals
    • SPD: Compatible with SPD and most SPD-compatible clipless pedals
    • Coming soon: Crankbrothers compatible versions coming in 2027 – sign up here to be notified
  • Retail Price (MSRP):
    • $59.99 USD | £49.99 GPB | €59.99 EUR | $79.99 CAD | $99.99 AUD
    • 25% Off at Launch as part of Redshift’s Early Black Friday Sale
  • Available to order from the Redshift website, ship dates vary by region & SKU

The simple two-piece design locks in just like your cleat would, aided by an easy-to-access lever that eases entry and exit. The Look Keo and SPD-SL versions work essentially like the original SPD version, and share the same big-but-not-too-big 80 x 105mm platform. They’re just 10 mm thick, and a pair will securely snap together with embedded magnets to make for a pocket-sized package when not in use.

They’re also available in a handful of colors, ranging from quiet to loud. We think the teal / pink looks great in person, but you do you. Oh, and for those of you who run Crankbrothers pedals, you are not forgotten. Redshift revealed they’re working on an Eggbeater-style Mousetrap for 2027. But if you’ve got Look Keo, SPD, or SPD-SL, act now. They’re 25% off at the time of publishing this.
